title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Just Cast the Perfect Third Hokage
content:
A new live-action Naruto feature film is now in the works, and a new report has revealed that the movie has locked down the perfect star as the Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi. Naruto ‘s new live-action movie is currently slated to fully go in production early next year, and that means we’re about to find out much more about the project. With a worldwide casting search kicking off this year for its three leads , the rest of the cast is steadily coming together as well.

Deadline now reports that Shogun, Mortal Kombat, and John Wick franchise star Hiroyuki Sanada has been cast in the role of the Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi. The Hokage plays an incredibly important mentor role for Naruto and the rest of the Hidden Leaf Village as they face off against all sorts of threats, and could even see some notable action himself depending on how much the new movie decides to cover in the future .

Hiroyuki Sanada Joins Live-Action Naruto Movie as the Third Hokage

The new Naruto live-action movie is now in the works, but has yet to nail down a concrete release date or window as of this time. Production on the project is set to begin in Spring 2027 with Lionsgate overseeing the production and domestic region release, and Sony Pictures overseeing its international distribution and co-financing. A worldwide casting search began this year for its main trio of Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, and Sakura Harada, but no casting has been revealed as of this time. Nothing has been officially set in stone.

It’s the same for Charles Melton as Kakashi Hatake, who has been reportedly cast in the new Naruto movie as wel l. But we’ll likely see forward momentum on everything now that we’re so close to the end of the year, and that includes getting a better handle on what kind of materials from Masashi Kishimoto’s original manga the new film will end up using. Various reports have claimed to know what it’s going to cover, but that’s all still a mystery until it officially kicks off its production next year.

What to Know for Naruto ‘s New Live-Action Movie

Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton is coming off of the massive blockbuster success of that film to direct the new live-action Naruto movie for Lionsgate Pictures and Sony Pictures. Cretton is also co-writing the new movie together with Tasha Huo, and is a co-producer alongside Jeyun Munford through Hisako with Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu of Arad Productions. J eremy Latcham was previously attached to the film as a producer before dropping out to become the new head of DC Studios under Skydance.

Reports have teased that the Naruto live-action outing will be taking on the Land of Waves arc of the manga, which was one of Naruto’s first missions as a member of Team 7 . The new film could switch up some things for this new take on the material, but it would serve as a great entry point for this next generation of the franchise. But how are you feeling about Hiroyuki Sanada joining the Naruto movie as the Third Hokage? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – Deadline

title: Dark New Zombie Anime Confirms January 2027 Release Date Ahead of Debut
content:
One of the most anticipated horror anime of 2027 confirms its release date and Japanese broadcast information with a new visual. 2026 is almost nearing its end, which is why the next year’s lineup is revealing all the major information fans can expect. 2027 is going to be yet another exciting year for anime fans, maybe even better than this year. The year will kick off with the Winter 2027 season, which is only a few weeks away. One of the most exciting anime of the season is In a World Full of Zombies I’m the Only One Who Doesn’t Get Attacked , a zombie horror series.

There has been a shortage of zombie movies in the industry for quite some time, even though Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead was quite a massive hit in 2023. However, this new zombie series is expected to be the next big hit. The official X handle of the anime confirmed that AT-X on Friday, January 1, 2027, at 1:00 a.m. JST. The streaming platform hasn’t been revealed yet, but we can expect an update before the end of the year. Along with the broadcast information, the handle post also includes an older visual featuring the central characters.

What Is In a World Full of Zombies I’m the Only One Who Doesn’t Get Attacked About?

The anime is based on a light novel series of the same name written by Rokuro Uraji and illustrated by Saburo. The story centers around an ordinary office worker, Yusuke, who dislikes people and prefers to do his job in silence. However, when the company he was employed at goes bankrupt, he loses his job and becomes a shut-in with no motivation to work again. On a rare day, he leaves his apartment after playing video games for a week but never expected a mysterious man to bite his arm.

While Yusuke avoids getting hurt anymore, he becomes bedridden with a fever, never expecting the world would change when he was asleep. He sees that zombies have emerged in every corner of the world and only a few humans have survived the apocalypse. For some reason, he is the only one who isn’t getting attacked by zombies, and it might be related to his unexpected encounter with the man who bit him.

This Upcoming New Zombie Anime Might Be the Next Big Hit

A zombie apocalypse is one of those premises that fans will always love, especially those who have been starving for a horror genre. With the anime being oversaturated with battle action that centers around supernatural power systems or isekai fantasies, horror shows have become quite a rarity. This is especially the case for shows centering around Zombies since the last time a major hit was released was more than three years ago.

Not only that, but this upcoming series also comes with its own set of mysteries and plot twists that set it apart from any ordinary horror show. The anime has yet to reveal any information regarding its global streaming, but we can expect any major platform such as Crunchyroll, Netflix, or HIDIVE to pick it up soon.

Are you excited to watch this upcoming zombie horror series? Do you think it could have the same appeal as the major shows of 2027? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Is Already Setting Up Ultra Instinct’s Debut
content:
Dragon Ball Super ‘s new remake has officially kicked off the Resurrection F arc with its latest episode, and Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has also planted the first seeds for Ultra Instinct Goku’s big debut. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is a newly enhanced version of the now classic TV anime series, and with the benefit of retrospect has been able to fine tune how each of the episodes play out knowing what’s next to come in the future. That’s what makes its newest addition all the more interesting.

Dragon Ball Super fans know that the anime eventually reaches its climax with the full debut of Mastered Ultra Instinct Goku , and Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been able to use that to start planting the seeds for it much sooner than usual. Because while the anime hasn’t really changed any of the audio or story sequences from the original, it’s been able to add a new visual flourish to help set up Ultra Instinct’s eventually debut with the latest episode.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 7 Teases Ultra Instinct

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 7 kicks off the Resurrection F arc with Goku and Vegeta training with Whis on Beerus’ planet . This training segment is extended beyond what was seen in the original version as well as the conversation that Whis has with the two of them about their strengths and weaknesses. When Whis tells them they will need to train their body to move before they even think of those movements, the new version now adds a flair of silver aura that wasn’t in the original. It’s because now the team knows what Ultra Instinct already looks like.

Rather than like the first time around where the Dragon Ball Super anime production team were kind of figuring things out alongside Akira Toriyama as the series developed, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is able to use those future events to foreshadow them much sooner than before. It makes for a more complete experience for those new audiences who are just jumping into the anime with this new edition, and will hopefully make Ultra Instinct that much more explosive if/when the remake eventually gets to the Tournament of Power.

What Does This Mean for Dragon Ball Super’ s Remake Anime Future?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has only been confirmed to enhance the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs before it comes to an end. It’s yet to be revealed as to whether or not the Future Trunks and Universe Survival arcs are going to get the remake treatment next, but that seems likely given that these three arcs have gone through the trouble of being reinterpreted in this way. That’s going to be even more necessary to bridge the gap to the Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol anime at some point too.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been divisive thus far with the number of changes it has made to the classic TV anime, and the lack of new additions seen with the episodes so far . But with foreshadowing like this to help make the package seemed like it was all planned out from the start, it’s going to make this new version the most complete version of the story. But how are you feeling about Dragon Ball Super: Beerus so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Re:Zero Star Breaks Silence on Anime’s Future After Season 5
content:
The voice behind Subaru Natsuki finally shared the anime’s future even after Season 5. 2026 was a major year for Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World – fans, as the anime not only aired its fourth season, but also commemorated its 10th anniversary. The fifth season has already been confirmed, and it’s going to be more intense than ever. The anime is based on an ongoing novel written by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka. As one of the biggest shows on Crunchyroll, it’s no surprise Re:Zero was renewed for a fifth season not long after the fourth season finale.

The story is currently at a crucial phase as Subaru Natsuki was forced to witness his friends die in gruesome ways, forcing him to realize his weakness. Fans are more excited to see his journey continue in Season 5, especially after Rem woke up from her coma. During the anime’s 10th anniversary event last week, the voice actors were in attendance and discussed their experiences working on the series for a decade. The anime has only just confirmed its fifth season, but Yusuke Kobayashi, the voice behind Natsuki Subaru, already revealed what to expect from the anime going forward.

Re:Zero Voice Actor Confirms the Anime Will Run For a Long Time

Mantan Web shares his speech during the event, where Kobayashi says, “This toast is not a toast to a milestone, but the first call to continue running. We will continue to run for a long time to come, so we would be happy if you would continue to support and run with us in the world of Re:Zero , which may continue for decades to come.”

Since the novel is ongoing, it goes without saying that the fifth season won’t be able to adapt the entire story. Since the anime is already popular, fans will keep getting sequel seasons until the story is over. Kobayashi’s closing remarks during the event confirm that the anime has a long future ahead, which may even continue for decades. In February this year, Nagatsuki confirmed that the novel’s story is only halfway over after 14 years of serialization. This means the anime will keep releasing more seasons for another decade or even more.

Re:Zero Season 5 Will Be More Brutal Than Ever

During the Season 5 announcement, Nagatsuki shared a special message to fans while dropping major hints about what to expect from the anime. While the creator didn’t drop any major spoilers, he revealed that the but the journey from here on out will be even more grueling than ever, even comparing it to an inferno.

Season 4 was already a brutal journey , but Subaru won’t be able to catch a break in the upcoming season as well. Nagatsuki also assures fans that the journey from here on out won’t be all about hardship. Fans can also look forward to new encounters and exciting developments, which means we can expect new character introductions in Season 5 as well.

What are you most excited to see in the anime’s Season 5? What do you hope will happen next in Subaru’s journey? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: Lost Cartoon Network Classic Finally Getting Streaming Release After 23 Years
content:
A lost Cartoon Network classic animated series is finally getting its own proper streaming release 23 years after it first began, and it’s going to be available completely for free. It’s been a tumultuous few years for Warner Bros. Animation and their classic library as not only is the future of it even more uncertain following the Skydance merger, but their properties had since moved to other streaming services. Though Tubi has really been coming through in the last year specifically .

Tubi has been launching Warner Bros. Animation’s classic cartoon library on a rotational schedule through the past year or so , and a new wave of releases is gearing up for their launch on the free streaming service this December. It’s been announced by the platform’s social media account that beginning on December 1st, Duck Dodgers is going to be available for streaming. Marking the first time it’s been available in this way in quite some time.

Duck Dodgers Confirms December 2026 Tubi Streaming Launch

Duck Dodgers will be coming to Tubi on December 1st alongside the streaming releases of MAD, Wacky Races , and Xiaolin Showdown . It’s yet to be revealed how long it’s going to be available to watch on the platform, but it’s going to be totally free. Given how some of the other series have only been available for a few months at a time, it’s best to jump back into the classic series now before it’s too late. And you’re definitely going to want to as it’s a hidden gem of the 2000s era of Cartoon Network.

Based on the original Looney Tunes short, “Duck Dodgers of the 24th 1/2 Century,” Duck Dodgers made its full series debut with Cartoon Network in 2003 . Running for a couple of seasons before it eventually came to an end in 2005, and expanding on that original idea, Daffy Duck stars as the titular Duck Dodgers alongside his trusty Space Cadet Porky. The two go on all sorts of space adventures with many of them facing off against Martian threats. But it had a whole life of its own with all sorts of fun moments you’re going to want to see again.

Why You Need to Watch Duck Dodgers

Duck Dodgers had a ton of fun with its premise because while it might have been inspired by the Looney Tunes short, it wasn’t just limited to interactions with other Looney Tunes franchise characters. The series expanded the world around Dodgers, and made references to other major shows at the time such as Samurai Jack , had cameos from famous bands such as Megadeth, and even had a full episode where he became a member of the Green Lantern Corps for a brief time .

The Looney Tunes have been in the midst of a major pop culture resurgence in the past few years thanks to the success of new projects such as Coyote vs. Acme and The Day The Earth Blew Up . But with the loss of Eric Bauza the future of it all remains uncertain . The best way to enjoy it all for now is to seek out classics like this one, and watch it all from the very beginning. Are you going to check out Duck Dodgers on Tubi? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Akane-banashi Season 2 Announces January 9 Debut
content:
TV Asahi describes the story of the second season ( Note: the below summary contains spoilers for the end of the first season ):

What you're about to experience is nothing less than the living history of Rakugo. Inspired by her Rakugo father, Akane Osaki aims to become a Shin'uchi. After graduating high school, she formally joins Shiguma's school. Now known as Akane Arakawa, she takes her first steps as a Rakugoka. She arrives at Yasaka-tei, a traditional, bustling Rakugo theater. Surrounded by Shin'uchi, Akane finally begins her training at the heart of Rakugo performers. A full-fledged story of Rakugo, where master storytellers compete. The Zenza Arc begins!

New cast members for the second season include Taku Yashiro as Asagao Konjakutei and Yōji Ueda as Hassho Tsubakiya.

New characters who appeared in the final episode of the first season and their cast members include:

• Hōchū Ōtsuka as Miroku Kashiwaya

• Ryōtarō Okiayu as Shomei Tsubakiya

• Hiroshi Naka as Enso Sanmeitei

• Mutsumi Tamura as Urara Ransaika

• Shinichirō Miki as Ryu'un Kenputei

• Tomokazu Seki as Chocho Konjakutei

The first season began airing on TV Asahi 's "IMAnimation" programminb block on April 4, and ended in June with the conclusion of the show's Karaku Cup Arc. The anime also has its own " Akane-banashi Global" YouTube channel , where full episodes stream for free in North America and Latin America, after their television broadcast in Japan. Netflix debuted the English dub for the first two episodes on May 17 and launched later episodes weekly.

The anime is also streaming on aniverse in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. ADN is streaming it in France, Monaco, Andorra, Switzerland, Belgium, and Luxembourg. Anime Box is streaming it in Spain and Anime Generation is streaming it in Italy. The Ani-One YouTube channel is streaming the anime in the Asia Pacific (excluding Korea and China). Bahamut, ChungHwa Telecom MOD & Hami Video, LiTV & Ofiii, Line TV, My-Video , Catchplay, and friDay are streaming the anime in Taiwan. Bahamut is streaming it in Hong Kong and Macao. Catchplay is streaming it in Indonesia and TrueID is streaming it in Thailand. playmax.mn STAR TV is streaming it in Mongolia. Laftel and Aniplus Channel are streaming it in South Korea.

title: Shonen Jump’s Best New Anime Confirms Release Date for Season 2 Return
content:
One of Shonen Jump ‘s best new anime releases has now set a date for its Season 2 return to screens next year, so it’s time to get ready. Shonen Jump has had a lot of its newer titles getting their own official anime adaptations over the past year or so, but one of them has stood out a s being one of the more unique anime releases yet. That’s the case for the adaptation taking on Yuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue’s Akane-banashi , and it’s coming back for its second season soon.

Akane-banashi made its initial debut for the anime’s first season earlier this Spring, and was such a hit that it was quickly confirmed that a second season was already in the works . After teasing it here and there over the past few months, the official social media for the series has now confirmed a January 9th release date for Akane-banashi Season 2 in Japan. But its international release plans have yet to be revealed as of this time.

When Does Akane-banashi Season 2 Come Out?

Akane-banashi is currently scheduled to make its broadcast debut in Japan on January 9th, and will be coming to platforms such as Netflix in the region starting on January 10th as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule. It’s yet to be revealed as to whether or not the franchise will be available to check out on the same platform in the United States, but you can catch up with the first season now streaming with both Netflix and for free on its official YouTube channel as of this time. It could be the same case for its coming season as well.

The production staff from the first season is set to return with Ayumu Watanabe directing Akane-banashi Season 2 for ZEXCS with scripts provided by Michiro Tsukiya, character designs provided by Kii Tanakam and music composed by Akio Izutsu. The voice cast from the first season are set to reprise their respective roles as well, and a few new additions to the cast include the likes of Taku Yashiro as Asagao Konjakutei and Yoji Ueda as Hassho Tsubakiya. And there’s plenty to look forward to in the coming episodes.

What’s New for Akane-banashi Season 2?

The end of the first season saw Akane promoted to Zenza status , and now that’s the focus of the next step on her journey with Akane-banashi Season 2. She’s going to learn more about the art of Rakugo and understand her own style with it by observing even more new allies and rivals in the coming arc. She’s about to enter a whole new league of talent, and find out whether or not she will sink or swim in this art form. And find out whether or not all her success to this point had been a fluke.

This wasn’t the only new Shonen Jump series to make its debut with a new anime through the year thus far, but it’s certainly one of the most interesting when stacked up with all of the other debuts. Akane has been one of the most compelling protagonists, and that’s even more true thanks to its successful anime translation of the manga so far. But what are you hoping to see in Akane-banashi Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments.

title: One Piece Finally Reveals Imu’s Official Design With Full Look at Its Biggest Villain
content:
One Piece is now in the midst of the series’ biggest fight yet as Luffy and Imu are squaring off in the latest chapters of the series , and now series creator Eiichiro Oda has fully revealed what King Imu actually looks like after all this time. Imu was first introduced to the series nearly a decade ago when it was revealed that there was a mysterious king sitting on a throne at the middle of the world. But this king has made his move much sooner than expected with the climax of the Elbaph Arc.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc has been getting much more intense with each passing chapter , and Imu has revealed his full self now that he’s come to Elbaph to make his move against Luffy and the Giants. With the release of One Piece Volume 116 coming to shelves in Japan later this December, the official social media for the series has now revealed its official cover in full and now given fans a full look at what Imu actually looks like. You can check it out below.

One Piece Volume 116 Cover Art Reveals Imu’s Official Design and Color Scheme

One Piece Volume 116 will be hitting shelves in Japan on December 4th, but no international release date has been announced as of this time. It will be collecting Chapters 1180 to 1190 of Eiichiro Oda’s original manga series, and that’s why it makes a lot of sense that Imu is taking place front and center. His emergence on Elbaph has been the biggest thing to happen in the series over the last few months, and we’ve only started to see Imu getting even stronger from there.

With Luffy and the others complicating things on Elbaph , Imu arrived on the island as taking it over is going to be very important for whatever plans he might have for the world. While there are still many questions about his origins and the nature of his power, this full devil look for the villain is something that had only emerged once he stepped out of the Holy Land. Which means the black silhouetted figure we had seen before was not just an editorial decision, it was how every other character actually saw the king before.

What Does Imu’s Arrival Mean for One Piece’ s Future?

The latest One Piece chapters have seen Luffy and the others struggling against Imu, but there are some surprising new reveals that have come as a result. It’s been confirmed that Imu is on some sort of deadline with how long he can be outside of the holy land as he notes he was reaching his limits, and it seems his presence has had some sort of adverse impact on Luffy’s Gear 5 form ( and pushing it to a berserk new kind of level never seen before ). But it’s only started to raise more questions.

It’s clear that as One Piece ‘s Final Saga reaches the climax of the Elbaph Arc that the series really is in the midst of its endgame. It’s yet to be revealed how many weeks, months or years it make take before Oda actually does end the series, but that grand finale is more real than it ever has been. How are you liking seeing Imu in action with One Piece’s latest chapters? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: 'Psyren' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced supporting cast on Monday. The anime series premiered on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.

Cast Kagetora Hyoudou: Takaya Kuroda ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) Ian: Wataru Komada ( One Punch Man 3 ) Kyle Tenjuin: Mutsumi Tamura ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) Shao Tenjuin: Mitsuki Saiga ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) Frederica Tenjuin: Ayana Taketatsu ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) Marie Tenjuin: Kana Ichinose ( Medalist )

Katsumi Ono ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) is directing the anime at Satelight , with Shin Yoshida ( Sacred Seven ) handling the series composition. Shiro Ookuma ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume o Minai animation director) is designing the characters. Takashi Oomama ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( Ore wa Subete wo "Parry" suru ), and Shuu Kanematsu ( Hametsu no Oukoku ) are composing the music.

Iwashiro drew the sci-fi action manga in Weekly Shounen Jump from December 2007 to November 2010. Shueisha published the 16th and final volume in March 2011.

SOW penned a side story light novel with illustrations by Iwashiro under Shueisha's Jump J Books imprint from September 2010 to March 2011.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in April 2010 and published the 16th and final volume in May 2014.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Teases Yuno’s Next Big Power Up
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is reaching its final phase as the Spade Kingdom Raid arc is winding down its final battles, and the first look preview for the next episode of the series is setting the stage for Yuno’s next big power up. With the first two members of the Dark Triad now defeated , all that stands in the way of the Advent of Qliphoth ritual is Zenon Zogratis. While Yuno and Langris had been able to deal damage to him, the end of the latest episode saw him strike a terrible deal.

Black Clover Season 2 saw Yuno and Langris pretty much defeat Zenon thanks to their teamwork , but the Zogratis sibling saved himself by making a new deal with the Supreme Devil, Beelzebub. Giving himself a devil’s heart and new strength as a result, Yuno is now struggling to survive. But the first look images and synopsis for Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 teases that Yuno is about to unlock a whole new power. Check them out in the gallery below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 First Look Images & Synopsis Revealed

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 is titled “Yuno Grinberryall” and will be making its debut in Japan on November 28th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. With the latest episode seeing Zenon strike a deal that pretty much puts him on the same level of a Supreme Devil, Yuno and Langris are pretty much out of options. Even with Finral arriving to help, there’s still a huge gap in their respective abilities. But the synopsis teases how the scales will balance.

“Yuno, Langris, and Finral are in dire straits under attack from Zenon, who has obtained the heart of a demon,” the synopsis begins. “Despite being chosen as the vice-captain of the Golden Dawn, the strongest magic knight squad in the Clover Kingdom, Yuno gnashes his teeth at his inability to protect his comrades, when a grimoire descends upon him.” By the sounds of things, Yuno is about to unlock a whole new kind of magic he didn’t have before. And it ties to the title of the episode, which fully reveals Yuno’s name . We’ll have to see what that means for the fight moving forward.

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

Each new episode of Black Clover Season 2 thus far has been packed to the brim with materials adapted from Yuki Tabata’s original manga, and that means these war events have been speeding towards their eventual conclusion. Because while this fight with Zenon is surely going to get a lot of focus, the synopsis also teases other key points in the fight, “Meanwhile, at the site of the Qliphoth’s arrival, Dorothy’s dream magic is defeated by Morris, who has acquired the power of a demon.” But that’s not all as the Black Bulls make their move too.

“Just as the gate to the second level of the Underworld is about to open, members of the Black Bulls arrive on their Black Raging Bull to rescue Yami!” the synopsis concludes. The Spade Kingdom Raid arc is quickly reaching its conclusion with the end of this second season, so it remains to be seen what’s next for the anime as it readies for the grand finale after . What do you hope to see from Yuno in Black Clover ‘s next episode? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.
